decisions.reason: The rotating-skip compact dumper extends the firm's established construction range, uses existing engineering and service capabilities, and was launched only recently in a growing industry.
The articulated construction dumper builds on the firm's core competence in rugged vehicles and gives it a broader construction offering with low incremental cost.

The mine rescue vehicle is distant from the core offer and serves a niche market, but it fits the firm's underground expertise and specialized problem-solving profile, so it will likely be given more time.
The multi-model compact telescopic loader line represents a substantial investment in an adjacent lifting segment, which makes withdrawal one year after launch unlikely.
